7 Drums 17 Artists is an interdisciplinary collaboration between seven
contemporary artists, musicians and scientists, spanning seven years
and several continents, curated by Everard Findlay.



Tuesday, December 10-

Jaron Lanier, celebrated inventor, author, musician, composer, and
Brian Greene, famed theoretical physicist, joins Elliott Mannette in a
conversation about the steel drum, the physics of sound and the
mapping of musical structure onto a 3D object. In this seminal
dialogue, Lanier offers his inimitable scientific insight into Mannette's
experiential tuning process and the technical virtuosity required to




                                                                              EFTA_R1_00404070
                                                                                 EFTA01943470
 discover the steel drum's unique tonal placement. The conversation will
be moderated by physicist Dr Stephon Alexander.



Wednesday, December 11-

Trinidadian artist Che Lovelace gives a performance piece in which he
re-contextualizes an oil barrel - a found object linked to the steel drum's
development. In this piece, the oil barrel is presented in relation to the
body, to Caribbean cultural ritual and the larger idea of creative
technique.Following Che's piece, Olof Dreijer of The Knife and Elliott
Mannette come together for a musical performance and discussion.
Dreijer speaks about his process as a composer, his use of steel drum
in particular tracks, and the state of electronic music. Mannette weighs
in on a conversation with Olof about contemporary iterations of the
steel drum, and in both contradistinction and comparison, reflects on
his analogue musical invention.
